name: DMAgic (F018B) / Enhanced DMA
_comment: Quelle: MEGA65/mega65-core iomap.txt; erzeugt von tools/gen_chips_mega65.py

regs.name: addrlsbtrig
regs.doc: DMAgic DMA list address LSB (bits 0 - 7), trigger DMA when written.

regs.name: addrmb
regs.doc: DMA list address mega-byte (bits 20 - 27). Overlaps with ADDRBANK!

regs.name: etrig
regs.doc: Set low-order byte of DMA list address (bits 0 - 7), and trigger Enhanced DMA job, with list address specified as 28-bit flat address (uses DMA option

regs.name: etrigmapd
regs.doc: Set low-order byte of DMA list address (bits 0 - 7), and trigger Enhanced DMA job, with list in current CPU memory map (uses DMA option list)

regs.name: etriginline
regs.doc: Trigger Enhanced DMAgic job inline (i.e., beginning at PC value, and setting PC to end of job when done)

regs.name: addrlsb
regs.doc: DMA list address low byte (bits 0 - 7) WITHOUT STARTING A DMA JOB (used by Hypervisor for unfreezing DMA-using tasks)
